shortDescription: Retrieves process IDs list if the process is running otherwise return empty list

options.name: ignore_case
options.description: Ignore case in pattern if using the O(pattern) option.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the process(es) you want to get PID(s) for.

options.name: pattern
options.description: The pattern (regular expression) to match the process(es) you want to get PID(s) for.
